description: Email inboxes for AI agents, by the hour: pay in stablecoins, get an address, wait for a message with one call and read the code or the link out of it. This A2A agent is free and read-only: it answers questions about the API and explains which endpoint fits a task and how to get its quote. It places no paid calls, signs no payments and holds no accounts. Paid calls go over HTTP (https://agmail.shveik.dev/openapi.json) or MCP (https://agmail.shveik.dev/mcp), paid in stablecoins.
name: agmail

skills.description: Answers questions about the agmail API: its endpoints, request shapes, how a call is paid (x402 or MPP, stablecoins) and where the full docs are (https://agmail.shveik.dev/docs, https://agmail.shveik.dev/agents.md, https://agmail.shveik.dev/openapi.json). Free; it runs no scraping.
examples: How do I pay for a call?
Which endpoints are in the OpenAPI document?
skills.name: API and payment docs

skills.description: Explains which agmail endpoint fits a task and how to get its price quote: send the endpoint's JSON request over HTTP without payment, or call its MCP tool, and read the 402 quote. It signs no payment and places no paid call.
examples: How do I get a quote for a call?
skills.name: Endpoint choice and quote
